faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi Jal Board Law Officer (Water) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 17th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Law Officer (Water) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree along with a Three-year LLB degree and seven years of legal experience, or a Five-year integrated LLB degree with eight years of legal experience from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Law Officer (Water) post is 56 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Law Officer (Water) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in Pay Level-12, ranging from Rs. 78,800 to Rs. 2,09,200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Law Officer (Water) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Law Officer (Water) post in this recruitment drive by the Delhi Jal Board.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Delhi Jal Board Law Officer (Water) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Law Officer (Water) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this post is based on Deputation. Further details regarding the selection procedure will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Delhi Jal Board, which is www.delhijalboard.nic.in. The links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
